purpose: Development-side classification of existing case evidence. A profile is not a case admission or runtime resource.

dispositions.admit: Only a separately reviewed immutable admission record may support this disposition for its exact bounded scope.
dispositions.needs_evidence: Existing development evidence is insufficient for an admission claim.
dispositions.fail_closed: The mechanism must stop; no target or sequence may be chosen.
dispositions.counterexample_only: Retain as boundary evidence; it cannot support an admission claim.
